## Download

Scroll down to **Assets** and download the file for your computer:

| You have | Download |
|---|---|
| **Windows** | `EmberlinePoly-windows.zip` |
| **Mac** (Apple Silicon or Intel) | `EmberlinePoly-macos.zip` |

Ignore **Source code (zip)** and **Source code (tar.gz)** - those are for developers.

Unzip it and follow **INSTALL.txt** inside (it takes a minute). The zip contains the plugin (VST3, plus Audio Unit on Mac) and a Standalone app.

This is a **beta** and isn't code-signed yet, so Windows may show a SmartScreen warning (More info, then Run anyway) and macOS may say the developer can't be verified (right-click the file, then Open). INSTALL.txt explains both.

Emberline Poly is a MIDI generator: put it on an instrument track and send its MIDI output to a synth (see INSTALL.txt for how in your DAW). Found a bug? Please [open an issue](https://github.com/ljw46/EmberlinePoly/issues) with your DAW, operating system and the version shown under the title.

Enjoying it? [Buy me a coffee](https://buymeacoffee.com/emberlinesky).
